description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/nte-neverness-to-everness/

The first half of NTE V1.5 "Once Upon a Glitched Call" is coming soon with the new character Elyms, plus new vehicles and gameplay!

Describe ETD-6’s lieutenant in a few words. There’s probably not a soul at the Bureau who doesn’t know her, right? "Understanding", "easygoing", "cheerful", "mischievous", "approachable", "polite to a fault", "witty", "kind"... Bureau staff rattled off adjective after adjective, every one of them a trait that makes a person easy to like. Sure, a few of those words seem to clash a little. But it’s perfectly natural for different people to see someone slightly differently, so don’t think too hard about it. On one point, at least, everyone agreed without a shred of doubt: "my friend."

Jump in now to meet Elyms and take a spin around Hethereau together. Looks like today’s plans are all set!
